```sql
WITH RECURSIVE expanded_sku (sku_id) AS (
    SELECT s.sku_id
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.sku_code = 'NO8-140WHT92-UKR-72'
    UNION
    SELECT bi.item_sku_id
    FROM expanded_sku e
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = e.sku_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.model_code
FROM expanded_sku e
JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = e.sku_id
JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = sm.model_id
ORDER BY m.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_tree AS (
    SELECT
        sku_id,
        is_bundle
    FROM sales_sku
    WHERE sku_code = 'SW7-180BLK12-JP-74'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        s.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle
    FROM sku_tree AS t
    JOIN bundle_item AS b
      ON b.bundle_sku_id = t.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku AS s
      ON s.sku_id = b.item_sku_id
    WHERE t.is_bundle
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.model_code
FROM sku_tree AS t
JOIN sku_model AS sm
  ON sm.sku_id = t.sku_id
JOIN company_model AS m
  ON m.model_id = sm.model_id
WHERE COALESCE(t.is_bundle, FALSE) = FALSE
ORDER BY m.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        CAST(mb.qty AS BIGINT) AS total_qty
    FROM company_model m
    JOIN model_bom mb
      ON mb.model_id = m.model_id
    WHERE m.model_code = 'SW9-180WAL93-0190'
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR mb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        b.total_qty * CAST(cb.qty AS BIGINT)
    FROM bom b
    JOIN component c
      ON c.component_id = b.component_id
     AND c.is_assembly = TRUE
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = b.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR cb.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(b.total_qty), 0)::BIGINT
FROM bom b
JOIN component c
  ON c.component_id = b.component_id
WHERE c.component_code = 'FOO-192-WHT-02486';
```

```sql
    FROM sales_sku

    UNION
    SELECT s2.sku_id, s2.is_bundle
    FROM sku_tree st
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = st.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku s2 ON s2.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    WHERE COALESCE(st.is_bundle, FALSE) = TRUE
)

JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id

WHERE COALESCE(s.is_bundle, FALSE) = FALSE
ORDER BY m.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku AS (
    SELECT
        s.sku_id,
        s.is_bundle,
        [s.sku_id] AS path
    FROM sales_sku s
    WHERE s.sku_code = 'SW3-120WHT12-JPP-78'

    UNION

    SELECT
        item.sku_id,
        item.is_bundle,
        list_append(parent.path, item.sku_id)
    FROM sku parent
    JOIN bundle_item bi
      ON bi.bundle_sku_id = parent.sku_id
    JOIN sales_sku item
      ON item.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    WHERE parent.is_bundle = TRUE
      AND NOT list_contains(parent.path, item.sku_id)
)
SELECT DISTINCT cm.model_code
FROM sku s
JOIN sku_model sm
  ON sm.sku_id = s.sku_id
JOIN company_model cm
  ON cm.model_id = sm.model_id
ORDER BY cm.model_code;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'TE2-160WHT47-0726'
),
reachable AS (
    SELECT
        mb.component_id,
        ARRAY[mb.component_id] AS path
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN model m
      ON mb.model_id = m.model_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        cb.child_component_id,
        r.path || ARRAY[cb.child_component_id]
    FROM reachable r
    JOIN component parent
      ON parent.component_id = r.component_id
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = parent.component_id
    WHERE parent.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
      AND NOT array_contains(r.path, cb.child_component_id)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.component_id)
FROM reachable r
JOIN component c
  ON c.component_id = r.component_id
WHERE c.is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
WITH model_units AS (
    SELECT
        e.item_code AS model_code,
        SUM(ol.qty * e.qty) AS units_sold
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN listing l
      ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk
      ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN store s
      ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    JOIN u_explosion e
      ON e.root_kind = 'sku'
     AND e.root_code = sk.sku_code
     AND e.item_kind = 'model'
     AND e.valid_from <= o.order_date
     AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to >= o.order_date)
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
    GROUP BY e.item_code
)
SELECT model_code
FROM model_units
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, model_code
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom AS (
    SELECT
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        1.0 AS cum_qty
    FROM u_composition uc
    JOIN component c
      ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE uc.parent_kind = 'model'
      AND uc.parent_code = 'AL8-140OAK56-0056'
      AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-08-20'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-08-20')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.component_code,
        c.is_assembly,
        c.unit_cost,
        b.cum_qty * uc.qty::DOUBLE
    FROM bom b
    JOIN u_composition uc
      ON uc.parent_kind = 'component'
     AND uc.parent_code = b.component_code
     AND uc.child_kind = 'component'
    JOIN component c
      ON c.component_code = uc.child_code
    WHERE b.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND uc.valid_from <= DATE '2025-08-20'
      AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to >= DATE '2025-08-20')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN is_assembly = FALSE THEN cum_qty * COALESCE(unit_cost, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            2
        ),
        0
    ) AS total_parts_cost
FROM bom;
```
